title: Display follow-ups from the WCLI-100 review: a non-ASCII positive control and the display.ts comment
description: Not a flip gate. LOWs of the round-2 Opus review of opum-ai/ward-cli#233 (merged f0a1ef5): (2) add a positive control showing ordinary non-ASCII text such as cafe with an acute accent and a CJK word passes escapeForDisplay unchanged, so the new Default_Ignorable_Code_Point escape cannot be mistaken for escaping all non-ASCII; (3) the comment at src/domain/display.ts lines 24 to 27 should say every Default_Ignorable_Code_Point, for example the listed ones, instead of an enumerated list that reads as complete.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A test asserts ordinary non-ASCII text passes escapeForDisplay unchanged
The display.ts comment says every Default_Ignorable_Code_Point, for example the listed ones
